name: nanobot
description: Ultra-lightweight self-hosted personal agent that runs in a WebUI, terminal or chat apps with tools, memory and scheduling.
publisher: HKUDS (University of Hong Kong Data Intelligence Lab)
whatItDoes: Handles personal automation and long-running goals using file, shell, web search, web fetch, cron, image generation and subagent tools. Connects to Telegram, Discord, Slack, WeChat, email, Mattermost, Linear and other channels.
howItWorks: A Python runtime keeps session history and long-term memory and can call MCP tools. It also exposes a Python SDK and an OpenAI-compatible API. The installer adds the `nanobot-ai` package and opens the WebUI for first-time provider setup.

requirements.name: LLM provider API key
requirements.description: Configured in the WebUI on first run
